status: Accepted for normal display loading and cover installation
user_statement: That new printed cover works great. In fact, it worked so well that the other parts of the faucet broke while I was trying to put that cover on, which I think really indicates that we have a brittleness issue with those cooling settings that we need to be aware of.
scope: This cover geometry with part cooling off passed the reported assembly. The comparison supports avoiding general cooling; it does not establish measured strength, cycle life, or acceptance of the raised-display geometry.
